synopsis: Millennium Falcon Owner's Workshop Manual is a book from Del Rey and Haynes that was released in the United Kingdom on November 3, 2011, and was released in the United States on January 31, 2012. It was written by Ryder Windham and illustrated by Chris Trevas and Chris Reiff.A new edition, titled YT-1300 Corellian Freighter Owner's Workshop Manual, was published in 2018.[
title: Millennium Falcon Owner's Workshop Manual
